li.label: my lucky {ITEM}
li.description: Nothing bad happens while I'm wearing it. That's just a fact.

li.label: without my lucky {ITEM}
li.description: Where is it? I don't feel right without it. Something's going to go wrong.

li.label: storms mean death
li.description: The last time the sky raged like this, someone died. Who is it this time?

li.label: night prayers
li.description: I say the words every night now. Someone, somewhere, is listening.

li.label: afraid of the dark
li.description: Ever since I lay there, unable to move, the dark feels like it's waiting.

li.label: battle ritual
li.description: Touch the doorframe, check the weapon twice, say the name. Then I'm ready.

li.label: the sun has gone out
li.description: I saw this in a dream. I know what it means. Nobody believes me.

li.label: the rain washes it away
li.description: When it rains, I stand outside for a while. It takes some of it with it.

li.label: under the open sky
li.description: I lay on the ground once thinking it was the last sky I'd see. Now I go and look at it whenever I can.

li.label: winter remembers
li.description: We lost someone in winter. Every winter since, I lose them again.
